title: GRACE-DE: Prospective Multicenter Real-world Gastric Cancer Patients Starting AZ-developed and Approved Drugs in Germany (Umbrella Study)
official: Prospective, Observational, Multicenter, and Multicohort Study of Patients With Gastric Cancer Initiating AstraZeneca-developed and Approved Drugs in Germany GastRic CAnCEr Real-World Evidence Germany (Umbrella Study)
summary: This is a prospective, non-interventional, observational, multicentre study evaluating the real-world effectiveness and safety of AstraZeneca-developed and approved medicines used to treat gastric and/or oesophageal cancers in Germany. The study is designed as an umbrella study comprising several drug- and indication-specific modules. The present description covers Module A, which evaluates durvalumab used perioperatively in combination with FLOT chemotherapy (D-FLOT), followed by adjuvant durvalumab monotherapy in adults with resectable gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma in routine clinical practice in Germany.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \- Age ≥18 years at the time of enrolment
* \- Patient is able to read and understand either German or English
* \- Histologically or cytologically proven resectable adenocarcinoma of the stomach or of the gastroesophageal junction (GC/GEJC) and decision to start perioperative treatment with durvalumab and FLOT chemotherapy (D-FLOT), followed by adjuvant durvalumab as monotherapy, according to its marketing authorization (SmPC). Inclusion can also take place after the 1st dose of perioperative D-FLOT but no later than 4 weeks after treatment initiation. (Modul A)
* \- Treatment decision was made independently from study participation
* \- Provision of signed and dated written informed consent to participate in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* \- Current active and already planned participation in an interventional clinical trial for stomach and/or esophageal cancer.
